products.title: Waxed Cotton & British Wool Blade Cover
products.body_html:
Blade Putter cover In Quilted Waxed Cotton Putter Cover With 100% British Wool. 

  • Hand Made In Yorkshire
  • British Wool & Waxed Cotton 
  • Brass Magnet Closure
  • Free UK Delivery  

Crafted from 100% waxed cotton, this quilted blade putter cover captures the timeless spirit of British country heritage.

Designed to offer both durability and understated sophistication, the waxed cotton outer is naturally water-repellent and can be easily rewaxed to maintain its distinctive character year after year.

The interior is lined with soft British wool, naturally cushioning your club and helping to prevent knocks and scratches while in your bag. Wool is highly breathable, moisture - resistant and naturally durable, making it an ideal protective lining for golf equipment.

The cover is secured with hidden brass magnets, providing a strong, reliable closure while maintaining a clean and traditional finish.

Features – Premium Materials

  • Outer: Made from 100% waxed cotton.
  • Inner: Lined with 100% soft British wool.
  • Water-repellent: Built to withstand the elements; easily rewaxable for long-term performance.
  • Secure fit: Brass magnets provide a firm yet easy closure.
  • British heritage: Waxed cotton and wool are cornerstones of traditional British country wear, valued for their durability, natural performance and timeless character.

Why British Wool Matters:

British wool has been part of the country’s textile heritage for centuries. It is naturally insulating, breathable and resilient, offering excellent protection while remaining environmentally responsible and sustainable. By using British wool, this cover supports traditional farming and helps preserve one of Britain’s most important rural industries.

Care:

Spot clean only. Rewax the waxed cotton outer as needed to maintain finish and weather protection.

A piece of heritage - handcrafted to endure and designed to age beautifully.

Fit:

Designed to fit most modern blade putters of around 3.5cm wide.
